hook: The complete playbook from broke to $1 million, in 9 stages, on an ordinary income. At $1,000 a month and 7%, the first $100,000 takes about 6.7 years, but the last $100,000 takes only about 16 months. In this video I look at the whole journey from three angles: the numbers (why it accelerates), the psychology (hopeless, boring, long, then sudden), and the 9-stage playbook with exactly what to do at each stage.
